hook.text: A team only writes unit tests and wonders why users still report usability issues. They're missing quadrants.

buildup.text: The agile testing quadrants organize tests into four categories based on purpose and audience.

discovery.text: Q1: tech-facing unit tests. Q2: business-facing functional. Q3: business-facing exploratory. Q4: tech-facing perf.

twist.text: Most teams over-invest in Q1 and ignore Q3. Exploratory testing catches the bugs automation misses.

climax.text: Balancing all four quadrants gives teams comprehensive coverage no single approach can achieve alone.

punchline.text: Four quadrants, four types of confidence. Cover them all.

quiz.question: What do the agile testing quadrants organize?
